headline: Chip stocks shed more than $1 trillion as selloff hits companies powering AI boom
detail: This is a direct hit to your core holdings (QQQ, SMH, SOXL, QQQI). The AI boom narrative, which has driven many of your names, is facing a significant pullback. This signals broad weakness in your concentrated sector.
rec: Consider trimming positions like SMH or SOXL, especially given their current losses and the sector-wide selloff.

headline: A profit squeeze is coming for tech. This manager is betting on these unglamorous stocks instead.
detail: This reinforces the negative outlook for tech, suggesting fundamental challenges beyond just a market selloff. A profit squeeze means less earnings growth, which could further pressure valuations for your tech-heavy portfolio.
rec: Avoid adding to existing tech positions or initiating new ones until there's clearer evidence of a turnaround in the profit outlook.

headline: ‘Nothing seems to shake this market.’ Why it’s time to go all-in on stocks, according to these bullish strategists.
detail: This presents a bullish counter-narrative for the broader market. While some strategists are optimistic, it directly conflicts with the specific negative news for your concentrated tech/chip sector.
rec: This broad bullishness doesn't negate the specific risks in your tech/chip concentration. Watch for signs if this sentiment can overcome sector-specific headwinds.
